name: Pidgeotto
description_en: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

name: Pidgeot
description_en: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

name: Oddish
description_en: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

name: Gloom
description_en: The nectar it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious that it can make noses curl from more than a mile away.

name: Vileplume
description_en: It has the world s largest petals. With every step, the petals shal out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Bellossom
description_en: Plentiful in the tropics When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Paras
description_en: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

name: Parasect
description_en: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back The mushroom appears to do all the thinking.

name: Venonat
description_en: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

name: Venomoth
description_en: The wings are covered with dustlike scales Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Bellsprout
description_en: It plants its feet deep underground to hydrate itself. While doing so, it's unable to run away if it's attacked.

name: Weepinbell
description_en: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

name: Victreebel
description_en: After dissolving many prey; this Pokémon's acid becomes sweete This makes it even easier to attract more prey.

name: Slowpoke
description_en: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowbro
description_en: When a Slowpoke Went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

name: Slowking
description_en: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, remains calm and collected.

name: Magnemite
description_en: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of it head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
description_en: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

name: Magnezone
description_en: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Onix
description_en: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Steelix
description_en: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Cubone
description_en: Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.

name: Marowak
description_en: Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.

name: Tyrogue
description_en: Its intense desire to become stronger and stronger drives it to recklessly train its body ad challenge any opponent it can find to battle.

name: Hitmonlee
description_en: It has complete control over the ligaments in its legs, expanding and contracting them to double the reach of its kicks.

name: Hitmonchan
description_en: It corners its foes with combo punches from both sides, then finished them off with a single strsight punch launched at over 300 mph.

name: Hitmontop
description_en: This Pokémon is adept at dance-like kicks. The horn atop its head is made from the same substance that generally forms fur and claws.

name: Koffing
description_en: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not onl smell; they - are also explosive.

name: Weezing
description_en: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting - them to the highest level.

name: Tangela
description_en: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Scyther
description_en: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Pinsir
description_en: It swings its long pincer horns wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

name: Magikarp
description_en: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
description_en: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Ditto
description_en: It can reorganize its cells to make itself into a duplicate of anything it sees. The quality of the duplicate depends on the individual.

name: Hoothoot
description_en: Hoothoot's internal clock is precise at all times. It tilts its head in a fixed rhythm.

name: Noctowl
description_en: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

name: Heracross
description_en: Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking through forests for it. The Pokémon uses its two antennae to pick up scents as it searches.

name: Volbeat
description_en: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise
description_en: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Gulpin
description_en: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

name: Swalot
description_en: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

name: Cacnea
description_en: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Cacturne
description_en: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day s desert heat.

name: Combee
description_en: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

name: Vespiquen
description_en: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

name: Shellos West Sea
description_en: This Pokémon can often be seen along seashores. It's capable of spending a limited amount of time on land.

name: Gastrodon East Sea
description_en: They normally inhabit rocky seahorses, but in times of continuous rain, they can sometimes be found in the mountains, far from the sea.

name: Drifloon
description_en: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "signpost for wandering spirits."

name: Drifblim
description_en: It can generate and release gas within its body. That s how it can control the altitude of its drift.
